propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeSmokeSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects smoke. HISTORY: PressureSensorSensorSetPoint (error in previous release) changed to SetPointConcentration. Range, accuracy and time constant deleted.

properties.name: CoverageArea
properties.definition:
The area that is covered by the object.

Floor area (typically measured as a circle whose center is at the location of the sensor).

properties.name: SetPointConcentration
properties.definition: The concentration to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

properties.name: HasBuiltInAlarm
properties.definition: Indicates whether the smoke sensor is included as an element within a smoke alarm/sensor unit (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
